content:
Alex: Hey team — I need to swap out of primary for tonight. Unexpected family thing, leaving in ~30m. Can someone pick up primary from 23:00-07:00 UTC? :wave:
Maria: I can take primary tonight. I’ll be available for the whole window. @Kevin you good to be secondary? :thumbsup:
Kevin: Yep I can be secondary. I’ll shadow for the first hour while Alex hands off details.
IncidentBot: ALERT posted: Pager escalations will continue as normal. Active incidents: 0. To acknowledge: `/ack 1790001111`
Alex: Thanks. Quick handoff notes — no active incidents, but expected increased DB compaction jobs around 02:00 UTC that can cause latency spikes. Watch the `inference-queue-ms` histogram and the `kv-cache-hit` rate.
Sophie: I can be the overnight backup (if both primary and secondary are down). Will monitor slack and PD for critical pages.
Maria: Got it. Alex, can you drop the runbook links and the last deploy ID?
Alex: Deploy ID: `deploy-2026-11-03-7f2a`. Runbooks: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/oncall and https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/db-compaction. Also the quick checks: ```
# check inference nodes
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --selector=app=redwood-inference
# tail recent errors
kubectl logs -n inference -l app=redwood-inference --tail=200 | grep ERROR
# check queue metrics
curl -s http://metrics.internal/api/series?name=inference-queue-ms | jq .
```
Kevin: Nice. Any temporary mitigations if the queue spikes?
Alex: If queue p95 > 300ms for >5min, escalate to Dedicated autoscaler: `team infra` and scale job shards: `POST /internal/scale?pool=inference-hot&factor=1.5` (ops token required). Also toggle prefix KV cache to aggressive: `kv_cache.set_policy("aggressive")` in the admin UI.
Maria: I'll note that. Who owns credentials for the scale endpoint tonight?
Alex: I'll leave the ops token in the secure notes in the runbook (accessible to oncall role). If you can't access it, ping @Sophie or @Kevin — they have emergency access.
IncidentBot: PAGE: PagerDuty incident created for high-latency thresholds. Summary: p95 inference latency > 300ms in eu-west-1. Trigger: 3m sustained. URL: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD1790001111
Maria: Acknowledging the page in case it fires. `ack` when you take it.
Kevin: Note for handoff: the monitoring alert has noisy siblings — check `latency_by_model` to determine if it's model-specific. If only one model spikes we can failover to the cheaper variant (model-v2 -> model-v2-quant) via router: `POST /internal/router/failover?model=model-v2&to=model-v2-quant`
Alex: Also leave a short blameless note if you do any manual scale or router change: `#oncall-notes` thread or the incident bot will pick it up. Example: "scaled inference pool by +50% at 02:12 UTC to mitigate p95 spike"
Sophie: I'll hold the emergency PD override if needed. Suggest we do a 10-min overlap — Maria, are you able to start shadowing at 22:50 UTC?
Maria: Yep, I’ll be online 22:50 and take over at 23:00. Kevin will be secondary from 23:00. Sophie backup. Alex will be reachable until 23:30 for questions.
Alex: Thanks all. Quick checklist before I head out:
• Confirmed deploy ID and runbooks shared
• Left ops token in secure runbook notes
• Noted DB compaction window (02:00 UTC)
• Overlap arranged (22:50–23:30)

If anything happens: primary handles page -> secondary picks up if primary out >5m -> escalate to backup.
Maria: Copy. I’ll also prepare a short alert playbook pinned in the channel: bullet steps and runbook pointers.
Kevin: I'll watch for false positives (noisy alerts) and call out if we should suppress duplicates.
IncidentBot: NOTE: On-call rotation updated: primary=Maria, secondary=Kevin, backup=Sophie, handoff_ts=1790002800
Sophie: Thanks. Good luck Alex, take care. :heart:
Alex: Appreciate it — leaving now. Ping me for anything weird in the first 30.
Maria: All set. I’ll post a short pinned message with the highlights and checkins for the night. :white_check_mark:
